message.text: There is no Redis configuration. The cache layer uses an in-memory store with a 10-minute TTL for user entries. User entries are set via Set() rather than SetWithTTL, so they inherit the default TTL.

r01.
There is no Redis. Caching is an in-process memory map (`store/cache.Cache`) created in `store.New` (`store/store.go`). User entries use that cache’s **DefaultTTL of 10 minutes** (`userCache.Set` in `store/user.go`, not a custom TTL).
